Let's talk about the hiring plan for the platform team. We have two open engineering roles and one open designer role. Lena has already screened 25 candidates for the engineering roles, and 6 are moving to the interview stage. The interview loop will be four rounds: a phone screen, a coding exercise, a system design chat and a team conversation. We decided not to use take-home assignments anymore, since candidates found them too long. Jonas will update the interview guide so every round has clear questions and a scoring sheet. I am worried that our onboarding is too informal, new people waited three days for laptop access last time. Decision: Lena owns the onboarding checklist, and IT must confirm laptop delivery before the start date. Question: should we pair each new hire with a buddy for the first month, or only for the first two weeks? Jonas thinks a month is better, but Lena said buddies get tired and two weeks is more realistic. We agreed to try six weeks of buddies for the next hire and then review how it went. The designer role is trickier, because we don't have a clear picture of what the portfolio review should include. Samira will draft the portfolio review criteria and share them by next Tuesday. Compensation bands are still not finalized, and we can't make offers until People Ops signs off. Lena will ask People Ops for a decision by Friday and escalate if we hear nothing by Monday. There was a short discussion about remote candidates, and we will not require relocation for either engineering role. However, the team lead should be within four hours of the main time zone. Jonas mentioned that two candidates asked about the on-call rotation, so we should be ready to explain it. Samira suggested we add a short written summary of the rotation to the offer packet. We should also decide who shadows the first interviews for the two newer engineers. Lena will schedule the shadow sessions and make sure feedback is written within 24 hours of each interview.

Marta asked about the paint color, and I think we agreed on a soft green, but I should double check with her. We will not paint the ceiling this time, it is fine for now.
